name: Dazu Rock Carvings
description: Scattered across the steep hillsides of Dazu District, about 165 km west of Chongqing, these carvings fill 75 protected sites with some 50,000 statues and over 100,000 inscribed characters. Cut mostly between the 9th and 13th centuries, they range from cave shrines to huge open-air reliefs. Mount Baoding and Mount Beishan hold the highlights, blending Buddhist, Taoist and Confucian themes with scenes of everyday life.
